run_gambas_benchmark_loss: run gambas_function with a random design array to compute the photonics benchmark loss value
run_gambas_benchmark_gradient: run gambas_function with wantgrad=True to compute both the loss and gradient for optimization
run_gambas_benchmark_fields: run gambas_function with wantfields=True to compute the loss and electromagnetic fields from the simulation
get_gambas_benchmark_name: get the human-readable benchmark name by calling gambas_function with x='name' and a benchmark_type
get_gambas_design_shape: get the expected design variable shape by calling gambas_function with x=None and a benchmark_type
